verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has a dedicated first-party server-side support docs page and a documented NullEngine class, which is its engine variant for running without a rendering context. Offscreen rendering is also documented, and the npm packages allow installation in Node or CI environments. Missing for 10: the evidence pack gives only titles and URLs for these pages, with no content on CI pipeline setup, headless rendering or screenshot output, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of headless or CI use.
